chunks: Then he said: Ali Baqbaqa said: I asked Safwan ibn Yahya, Ibn Jundab, and a group of their elders, and the discussion between them was significant:

Through which argument have you concluded regarding this man? Is it a specific proof that you have received, so you accept your own word? They all said: No, by God, except that he spoke, so we believed him. And they all referred to Al-Bazanti, so I said: Disgrace be upon you while you are the elders of the Shia! Do you send me to that lying child, so I should accept him and leave you?

key_terms.الصَّبِيِّ: The child/young one (referring to the Imam or a witness)
key_terms.الْبَزَنْطِيِّ: Al-Bazanti (a person referred to as a witness)
key_terms.صَفْوَانَ بْنَ يَحْيَىٰ: Safwan ibn Yahya (a prominent Shia scholar)

ai.seo_question: What was the basis of the Shia elders' belief in Imam Ali al-Rida according to Ali Baqbaqa's narration?
ai.summary: In this narrative from *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Baqbaqa interrogates prominent Shia elders like Safwan ibn Yahya regarding their acceptance of Imam Musa al-Kadhim (a.s.) during the period of the Minor Occultation. The elders admit their belief was based on the Imam's truthful speech rather than a rigorous logical proof, relying on Al-Bazanti as a witness. Baqbaqa critiques this reliance on a single witness ('that lying child') while dismissing the collective authority of the scholarly elders, highlighting the tension between individual testimony and communal scholarly consensus in establishing the Imamate.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 62 - Ali Baqbaqa said: I asked Safwan bin Yahya, Ibn Jundab and some of their associates – when an important discussion was going on between them:

Through which argument have you believed in the rightfulness of this person [Imam Ali Ridha (a.s)]? Do you have a valid argument that I may also accept your word? All of them replied: No, by God, [we don’t have any argument]. He only said: we have also testified [in blind imitation] and gave me the reference of Bazanti; till I said: For you the congregation of Shia elders is evil that they falsely sent me to that child so that I should accept him and leave you.
